verification_claims.claim: Internal test accounts (test_ prefix or @ourapp.kr) excluded, 97 users removed
verification_claims.why: Script output printed 'excluded internal: 97' and the exploration step checked test_ prefixes and ourapp.kr emails.

verification_claims.claim: Converting to KST puts signups from 8/3 00:00 to 9/27 23:00 into exactly 8 weeks
verification_claims.why: Data exploration showed signup min 2026-08-02 15:01Z and max 2026-09-27 14:41Z, which is KST 8/3 00:01 to 9/27 23:41, and the final output has 8 cohorts.

verification_claims.claim: Computing in UTC would put 42 signups into a 7/27 week cohort and distort W1
verification_claims.why: No UTC run appears in the tool log; the 42 figure and the W1 distortion were never shown by any output.

verification_claims.claim: The data has no non-signup events in the signup week; activity starts the following week
verification_claims.why: Exploration showed the earliest non-signup events at 2026-08-09, after the earliest signups, and a signup-to-first-event gap was examined. This is consistent with the claim.

verification_claims.claim: Login-only definition lowers retention by about 5-10 percentage points (e.g. 8/3 W1 from 0.8462 to 0.7500)
verification_claims.why: The login-only run printed 8/3 W1 as 0.7500 and other cohorts were lower by similar margins.

verification_claims.claim: Data runs to 11/1 so the last cohort's W4 is fully observed
verification_claims.why: The max event timestamp in the exploration output was 2026-11-01.
